newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B index ends up slightly on holiday mood.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B index ends up slightly on holiday mood.

text.p: Shanghai's B share index closed up slightly in light trading on Thursday ahead of the two-week Chinese lunar new year market holiday which begins next Monday, traders said.
The B index inched up 0.346 points or 0.53 percent to 65.784 points, on volume of 15.2 million shares worth $6.7 million against $7.2 million on Wednesday.
The Shanghai Stock Exchange will be closed from Monday, February 3 until Monday, February 17.
"Major investors have left the market on uncertainties over the holiday," one broker said. "Some window-dressing buying from the institutions pushed the index up."
"The index will consolidate in a narrow range tomorrow, the last session before the holiday," a second broker said.
Of 43 B shares, 41 traded with 22 up, eight flat and 11 down.
Huili Building Materials was the star on speculative buying, rising $0.014 or 5.26 percent to $0.280 on volume of 104,000 shares.
Forever Bicycle followed on a rebound, gaining $0.008 or 5.19 percent to $0.162 on volume of 310,000 shares.
Retailer Friendship traded the most on inter-institutional trading, up $0.006 or 1.39 percent to $0.436 on volume of 1.8 million shares.
Shanghai's A share market fell on a correction after gains in the past few days, but trading was dull in the run-up to the holiday, brokers said.
The A index fell 2.234 points or 0.22 percent to 1001.937 points, on volume of 324.8 million shares worth 2.9 billion yuan.
The SSE 30 index closed down 9.262 points or 0.36 percent to 2599.405 points.
New Asia Fast Food was the biggest loser on profit-taking after yesterday's jump, slipping 0.41 yuan or 4.93 percent to 7.89 yuan on volume of 317,900 shares.
